content.text:
I'd go with what the page puts at the top: an account at פסגות and the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", number 5139282. The page says I'd end up with about 86,942 ₪, from 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month for 10 years. I'm only half sure, so I would call you before I sign anything.

Son, here's how it went. What decided it was the first screen. The box marked "הבחירה שלכם · ★ הזול" says "86,942 ₪ נשאר לכם בעוד 10 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס". The next screen marks the same פסגות and the same ילין לפידות fund as the cheapest. But the list on the right shows פסגות as **86,492 ₪**, not 86,942. Same digits in a different order, so I don't know which one is right. Also, the 7% a year was already filled in on the page. I didn't choose it, and nobody promises it. I put in 70,000 ₪ and it says 86,942. That's less than I'd guess from 7% a year, which would be about 49,000 more.

**What I looked at, in order:**
1. **The top.** The title "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד". The page already had S&P 500 chosen. The boxes said 10,000 now, 500 a month, 10 years, 7%. I didn't touch the sliders. Then the box with the big number.
2. **The two lists, screens 2 and 3.**
   - On the right were the banks and what each leaves me: לאומי 83,396, הבינלאומי 82,371, מזרחי טפחות 82,282, הפועלים 81,471, דיסקונט 79,901.
   - So my own bank would leave me a few thousand shekels less than פסגות. In the small grey number under each bank, פסגות shows 1,057 ₪ and לאומי 4,541 ₪. I think that's what the bank takes, so yes, the bank takes more.
   - On the left was a long list of funds with coloured labels. Many have a red minus next to them, like "‎-447 ₪" and "‎-4,492 ₪". That frightened me.
3. **Screens 4 and 5.** Here it's all English names, like "iShares" and "Vanguard", with "אין מחיר כאן". Companies I've never heard of, like אינטראקטיב ישראל and Interactive Brokers. I skipped those.
4. **Screen 6.** A chart with four lines, so I didn't try to read it. Under it was a table: if I give 600 a month instead of 500, I'd have 100,966. Then a box about "נטרול מט"ח" with "‎-21.8% ב־2022". That's where I stopped. I'd been reading a long time, and the dark screen with all the numbers tired me out. I didn't read screens 7 to 10.

**Words I didn't understand:** S&P 500, MSCI, ETF, 4D/4A, "מדד" (to me that's the price index on the news), "קרן מחקה", "קרן סל", "צוברת", "מחלקת דיבידנד", "נאמן", "דמי משמרת", "מנוטרל מט"ח", "חשיפה לדולר", "עמלות זו על זו", "W-8BEN", "מול המדד", "‎+0.37% בשנה · שנה אחת".

**What I couldn't read well:** The small grey text under the list on the right. The very thin colour bars, where I can't tell yellow from orange. The small grey lines under the boxes at the top.

**What I'd change:**
- Put one sentence at the top saying how sure this is and that it can go down.
- Make the two numbers for פסגות match.
- Get rid of the dark background.
- Show fewer funds and fewer red minus signs.
- Write the words in Hebrew, not English letters.
